name: Multilingual Sentiment Pipeline
content: Multilingual Sentiment Pipeline (NLP & RAG): "One model reads the mood in four languages.". Most pipelines need a separate model for every language. This one uses a single multilingual model, so adding a language is a small change rather than a new project. The result is one self-contained HTML report you can open anywhere. Key highlights: **Didn't let Telugu fail silently:** the sentence splitter has no Telugu support, so I built and tested a fallback. **Highlights land on exactly the right words:** a test checks every sentence maps back to its exact place in the original text. Honest limitation/tradeoff: The 20/20 sentiment check uses clear-cut sentences, so it's a sanity check. Telugu isn't scored yet. Verified metrics: 4 languages · 1 model · 10 tests.
